summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot evidence confirms API access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep private and preview-only; rights outreach remains unsent pending counsel and owner authorization.

Fleet compliance disposition: CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Compliance baseline is 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown of 59 checked sites; open findings include banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms gaps. This is risk triage, not certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Evidence progress is limited to official Woot documentation and terms review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. No task is closed because direct evidence is incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. The concrete next evidence action is one dated readiness packet per site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Analytics and revenue evidence does not independently block ordinary compliant growth, but it does block unsupported ROI, revenue, or causal-lift claims. Analytics is healthy for configured sites; revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 with 6219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and 4.92 aggregate commission, including an unattributed aggregate row. Preserve site-level revenue, margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift as unknown.

Data-use review decisions: Woot deal and price-history data is BLOCKED pending rights evidence and human counsel; user alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED pending data-flow, retention, deletion, processor, consent, and unsubscribe evidence; GA4 is EVIDENCE_NEEDED pending deployed consent/configuration, retention, vendor, and jurisdiction evidence; operational logs and Cloudflare data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED pending log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and request-procedure evidence.
